shortDescription: PowerOn, PowerOff, modify_syscfg, modify_hwres, facts of the Managed system

options.name: action
options.description: C(poweroff) poweroff a specified I(system_name). C(poweron) poweron a specified I(system_name). C(modify_syscfg) Makes system configurations of specified I(system_name). C(modify_hwres) Makes hardware resource configurations of specified I(system_name). C(enable_pcm) Enables the Performance and Capacity Monitoring for specified types of utilization data. C(disable_pcm) Disables the Performance and Capacity Monitoring for specified types of utilization data.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IPaddress or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: mem_mirroring_mode
options.description: Configures the memory mirroring mode on specified I(system_name) for the next system poweron or system restart. User can use this option on only managed systems which supports memory mirroring. This option works with C(modify_hwres) I(action).

options.name: metrics
options.description: Provides five types of utilization data Long Term Monitor(LTM), Short Term Monitor(STM), Aggregated metrics(AM), ComputeLTM(CLTM), EnergyMonitor(EM). AM collects data from LTM and EM, hence when the AM is enabled automatically LTM and EM will be enabled. When LTM or EM is disabled then automatically the AM will also get disabled. This option works only with C(enable_pcm) and C(disable_pcm) I(action).

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name to be configured on specified I(system_name). This option works with C(modify_syscfg) I(action).

options.name: pend_mem_region_size
options.description: Configures the memory region size setting on specified I(system_name). choices are in MB. This option works with C(modify_hwres) I(action).

options.name: power_off_policy
options.description: power off policy to be configured on specified I(system_name). This option works with C(modify_syscfg) I(action). Configuring this option to '1' will power off the Managed System after all partitions are shutdown.

options.name: power_on_lpar_start_policy
options.description: power on partition start policy to be configured on specified I(system_name) for the next system restart. This option works with C(modify_syscfg) I(action).

options.name: requested_num_sys_huge_pages
options.description: Configures the number of pages of huge page memory. User can change this value only when the managed system is powered off. This option works with C(modify_hwres) I(action).

options.name: state
options.description: C(facts) fetch details of specified I(system_name) C(pcm_facts) fetch Performance and Capacity Monitoring details of specified I(system_name)

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.
